headline: HUMAIN named its first compute customer: Nebius takes up to 50 MW of the first 100 MW at Oxagon, NEOM, live from Q4 2027, with no server OEM named. At WETEX, DEWA signed Huawei through Moro Hub for ICT, data centres and servers, and Abu Dhabi's Aleria announced a 60 MW, 14,000-GPU Rubin site plus a 10 MW modular build with Hyperfusion. DDR5 spot rose to $61.100 and Gartner expects memflation through 2027, while Micron's Taoyuan strike fizzled. Houthi strikes on Dammam airport and Shaybah, and a US order for some diplomats to leave, froze corporate travel to Riyadh.
lenovo_read: Gulf AI buyers are signing tenants and sites first and choosing hardware later, so this quarter is the window to get onto the HUMAIN/DataVolt, Aleria and Hyperfusion bills of materials before Dell's GTC Berlin line-up does. Huawei's DEWA win shows Lenovo must be present at Gulf shows with a trusted sovereign stack. In KSA, plan for remote and one-to-one engagement while the security situation lasts.

pillars.dc: 4 scored: HUMAIN-DataVolt-Nebius 50 MW at Oxagon (OEM open), Aleria 60 MW Rubin and Aleria-Hyperfusion 10 MW modular (UAE), VivoPower-Open Innovation AI 1 GW heads of agreement. HUMAIN-Nvidia expansion held (no primary).
pillars.memory: 3 scored: Micron Taoyuan strike (small), Micron 4F2 roadmap, Seoul chip sell-off; Gartner memflation in Tier 3. DRAMeXchange 22 Oct: DDR5 16Gb $61.100 (+0.38%).
pillars.deals: 6 scored: DEWA-Huawei/Nozomi/Syskey, Zain-Ooredoo tower JV first close, OTEC-Publicis Sapient, Bahr Al Arab-KAU, Azm-NCGR, VivoPower-Open Innovation AI. No META round of $20M or more.
pillars.global: Samsung (Lee in UAE), Dell (GTC Berlin AI Factory), Meta (Q3 capex), Lenovo (SentinelOne ThinkShield). Chinese rule: Huawei (DEWA, Egypt pathology) scored; HONOR, Xiaomi, vivo, OPPO, Haier status lines.

stories.title: HUMAIN and DataVolt sign framework agreement with Nebius for large-scale campus in Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: HUMAIN, DataVolt and Nebius signed a preliminary framework making Nebius anchor customer for up to 50 MW of the first 100 MW at the 360 MW Oxagon campus, operational in phases from Q4 2027. Signed at GTC Berlin; no value; Tareq Amin calls Nebius HUMAIN's first customer.
bullets: Nebius would be an anchor customer, with the contemplated offtake representing up to 50 MW
HUMAIN and DataVolt had announced a partnership to develop 100 MW of the 360 MW AI-ready data center at Oxagon
The proposed capacity allocation is expected to become operational in phases from Q4 2027, and the agreement was signed on the sidelines of NVIDIA's GTC Berlin conference
stories.lenovo: First named HUMAIN tenant; compute is NVIDIA-powered but the server, storage and cooling OEM is undisclosed, so this is an open ISG opportunity via Nebius, DataVolt and MIS.
stories.arabic: وقّعت هيوماين وداتافولت إطاراً أولياً مع نيبيوس لتكون عميلاً رئيسياً بسعة تصل إلى 50 ميغاواط في حرم أوكساجون بنيوم، تبدأ مرحلياً من الربع الرابع 2027، دون الإفصاح عن مورد الخوادم.

stories.title: "بحر العرب" تعلن ترسية مشروع مع جامعة الملك عبدالعزيز بقيمة 13.8 مليون ريال
stories.summary: Bahr Al Arab Information Systems won a 3-year SAR 13.82M managed-services contract to operate and maintain King Abdulaziz University's e-systems; signing expected 19 Nov 2026.
bullets: بلغت القيمة الإجمالية للمشروع 13.82 مليون ريال سعودي شاملة ضريبة القيمة المضافة
يشمل المشروع خدمات مدارة لتشغيل وصيانة الأنظمة الإلكترونية لجامعة الملك عبدالعزيز ويمتد على مدار 3 سنوات
من المتوقع توقيع العقد في 19 نوفمبر 2026
stories.lenovo: Services-led; Bahr Al Arab is a listed Saudi SI to add to the channel map for university infrastructure refreshes.
stories.arabic: فازت بحر العرب لأنظمة المعلومات بمشروع خدمات مدارة لتشغيل وصيانة الأنظمة الإلكترونية لجامعة الملك عبدالعزيز لمدة 3 سنوات بقيمة 13.82 مليون ريال، ويتوقع توقيع العقد في 19 نوفمبر 2026.

stories.title: عزم: ترسية مشروع مع المركز الوطني لنظم الموارد الحكومية بقيمة 14.45 مليون ريال
stories.summary: Azm won a 36-month SAR 14.45M beneficiary-support project from the National Center for Government Resource Systems; award dated 7 Oct, notice received 21 Oct.
bullets: رست على عزم السعودية للاتصالات وتقنية المعلومات مشروع دعم أعمال المستفيدين لدى المركز الوطني لنظم الموارد الحكومية بقيمة 14.45 مليون ريال
مدة المشروع 36 شهراً، وتاريخ الترسية 7 أكتوبر 2026، واستلمت الشركة إشعار الترسية نهاية يوم الأربعاء 21 أكتوبر 2026
يشمل نطاق العمل دراسة الفجوات وتحليلها وتطوير المحتوى الإرشادي وتقديم خدمات دعم المستفيدين في استخدام خدمات الأنظمة
stories.lenovo: Services only; Azm is a candidate SSG/channel partner for government systems work.
stories.arabic: حصلت عزم السعودية على مشروع دعم أعمال المستفيدين من المركز الوطني لنظم الموارد الحكومية بقيمة 14.45 مليون ريال لمدة 36 شهراً.

stories.title: DEWA signs three agreements with global partners during WETEX 2026
stories.summary: Through Moro Hub, DEWA signed Huawei for hardware, software and support across ICT, networks, data centres, digital substations and cyber security, plus Nozomi Networks (OT security licences) and Syskey Softlabs (OT monitoring). No values.
bullets: The agreements were signed by Hussain Lootah, Executive Vice President of Transmission Power at DEWA, in the presence of Saeed Mohammed Al Tayer, and concluded through Moro Hub, a subsidiary of Digital DEWA

The agreement with Huawei covers hardware and software products, support and value-added services across ICT infrastructure, networks, data centres, digital substations and cyber security, including support for existing routers, servers and switches

The agreement with Nozomi Networks provides a unified framework for managing cybersecurity licences through the Nozomi Vantage platform, while Syskey Softlabs will provide OT log management, asset performance monitoring and network monitoring
stories.lenovo: Huawei is now DEWA's framework supplier for data centres and servers, a direct ISG loss of position; counter with a trusted non-Huawei stack for Moro Hub's regulated and AI workloads.
stories.arabic: وقّعت هيئة كهرباء ومياه دبي عبر مورو هب اتفاقية مع هواوي لتوريد الأجهزة والبرمجيات والدعم لبنيتها التحتية للاتصالات والشبكات ومراكز البيانات والخوادم، إلى جانب اتفاقيتين مع نوزومي نتوركس وسيسكي.

stories.title: Aleria Expands UAE Sovereign AI Capacity with 14,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs
stories.summary: Aleria is deploying about 14,000 Rubin GPUs, 6,000 Groq 3 LPX accelerators and 8,000 Vera CPUs on Vera Rubin NVL72 at a dedicated 60 MW UAE site with DDN storage. No go-live date or customers.
bullets: Aleria, an Abu Dhabi-based full-stack AI company and NVIDIA Cloud Partner, is deploying about 14,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs in a dedicated 60MW data center in the UAE
The deployment also includes 6,000 NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX accelerators and 8,000 NVIDIA Vera CPUs, with NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems as the core compute foundation
Multiple petabytes of DDN data storage will deliver over 17 TB/s of aggregate read throughput
stories.lenovo: Server OEM undisclosed: open ISG opportunity at a 60 MW UAE GPU site.
stories.arabic: أعلنت ألِيريا في أبوظبي نشر نحو 14 ألف معالج رسومي من إنفيديا روبين في مركز بيانات مخصص بقدرة 60 ميغاواط، وبناء مركز معياري بقدرة 10 ميغاواط مع هايبرفيوجن بتبريد سائل يدخل الخدمة في الربع الأول 2027.

stories.title: Aleria and Hyperfusion to Build Modular AI Data Center Designed with NVIDIA Vera Rubin in Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: A 10 MW modular AI DC in Abu Dhabi for Vera Rubin, racks above 200 kW, direct-to-chip liquid cooling with a 45°C warm-water loop; under construction, service entry targeted Q1 2027.
bullets: The 10MW modular AI data center in Abu Dhabi is designed for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform, with rack densities above 200kW
It uses direct-to-chip liquid cooling and a 45°C warm-water loop designed for Gulf conditions
The facility is under construction, with service entry targeted for Q1 2027
stories.lenovo: OEM undisclosed and a warm-water design that suits Neptune; links Hyperfusion OPP-096.
stories.arabic: أعلنت ألِيريا في أبوظبي نشر نحو 14 ألف معالج رسومي من إنفيديا روبين في مركز بيانات مخصص بقدرة 60 ميغاواط، وبناء مركز معياري بقدرة 10 ميغاواط مع هايبرفيوجن بتبريد سائل يدخل الخدمة في الربع الأول 2027.

stories.title: Zain and Ooredoo Combine 4,000 Towers in Regional Infrastructure Deal
stories.summary: First closing of the 50:50 Zain-Ooredoo regional tower platform combining Zain Kuwait (ITK) and Ooredoo Qatar (Al Abraj), about 4,000 towers; more portfolios to follow subject to approvals. No value.
bullets: Zain Group and Ooredoo announced the first closing of their regional tower platform, jointly owned with a 50% stake each
The platform combines Zain Kuwait's tower assets (ITK) and Ooredoo Qatar's tower assets (Al Abraj), approximately 4,000 towers
Additional tower portfolios will be added over time, subject to closing conditions and regulatory and other approvals, while each company keeps its active telecom infrastructure
stories.lenovo: A GCC TowerCo with an infrastructure-as-a-service model is a natural host for ThinkEdge compute at the tower, as with TAWAL (OPP-097).
stories.arabic: أعلنت زين وأريد الإغلاق الأول لمنصة الأبراج الإقليمية المملوكة مناصفة، بضم نحو 4,000 برج من زين الكويت وأريد قطر، مع إضافة محافظ أخرى لاحقاً بعد الموافقات.

stories.title: AI power demand underestimated, say 81% of energy executives
stories.summary: ADIPEC's Global Energy Report 2026 (Kekst CNC, 1,832 decision-makers, 78 countries): 81% expect AI-driven power demand to exceed forecasts; 43% say tech and AI firms gain most influence. ADIPEC 2-5 Nov.
bullets: Adipec's Global Energy Report 2026, conducted by Kekst CNC, polled 1,832 energy industry decision-makers across 78 countries
81% expect AI-driven electricity consumption to exceed existing projections, and 32% expect significantly higher demand
43% say technology and AI companies will gain the most influence over the energy sector, and Adipec takes place at Adnec Centre Abu Dhabi from November 2 to 5
stories.lenovo: Power is the Gulf AI constraint: supports Neptune liquid cooling and performance-per-watt messaging at ADIPEC.
stories.arabic: كشف تقرير الطاقة العالمي لمعرض أديبك 2026 أن 81% من قادة قطاع الطاقة يتوقعون أن يتجاوز الطلب على الكهرباء بسبب الذكاء الاصطناعي التوقعات الحالية.

stories.title: VivoPower, Open Innovation AI to develop sovereign AI data centers across Europe, Gulf and Asia
stories.summary: VivoPower and Abu Dhabi's Open Innovation AI signed a heads of agreement targeting at least 1 GW of sovereign AI DCs over three years across the Nordics, Europe, the GCC and Asia. Projects need separate agreements; no value.
bullets: VivoPower and UAE-based Open Innovation AI signed a definitive heads of agreement targeting at least 1 gigawatt of sovereign AI data centers over the next three years
Target regions are the Nordics, mainland Europe, the GCC region and selected Asian countries
VivoPower will handle site development, power procurement and facility operations, while Open Innovation AI provides orchestration, AI operations and the security layer
stories.lenovo: A target, not a build; hardware undisclosed. Watch for the first GCC project.
stories.arabic: وقّعت فيفو باور وأوبن إنوفيشن إيه آي اتفاق إطار لتطوير مراكز بيانات سيادية للذكاء الاصطناعي بقدرة لا تقل عن 1 غيغاواط خلال ثلاث سنوات في دول الشمال الأوروبي وأوروبا والخليج وآسيا.

stories.title: أوتك وبابليسيس سابينت تبحثان شراكة لدعم تبني الذكاء الاصطناعي المؤسسي في المنطقة
stories.summary: OTEC (Omantel's technology arm) and Publicis Sapient signed an MoU to explore enterprise AI adoption in Oman and MEA: solution design, innovation workshops and joint go-to-market.
bullets: وقّعت أوتك، الذراع التقنية التابعة لعُمانتل، وبابليسيس سابينت مذكرة تفاهم لدراسة فرص التعاون المشترك
يهدف التعاون إلى تسريع التحول الرقمي وتوسيع استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي في سلطنة عُمان ومنطقة الشرق الأوسط وأفريقيا
تشمل مجالات التعاون المحتملة تصميم الحلول التقنية وتنظيم ورش عمل للابتكار وإطلاق مبادرات تسويقية مشتركة
stories.lenovo: OTEC is Omantel's enterprise ICT channel; a potential ISG/SSG partner in Oman.
stories.arabic: وقّعت أوتك الذراع التقنية لعُمانتل مذكرة تفاهم مع بابليسيس سابينت لدراسة التعاون في تسريع تبني الذكاء الاصطناعي المؤسسي في عُمان والشرق الأوسط وأفريقيا.

stories.title: Samsung's Lee visits UAE power plant
stories.summary: Samsung Chairman Lee Jae-yong toured the Al Dhafra power plant site in Abu Dhabi on 21 Oct and met Samsung C&T and Samsung E&A executives as Samsung explores AI data centre and energy projects. No deal.
bullets: Lee Jae-yong toured the Al Dhafra gas-fired power plant construction site in Abu Dhabi on October 21
Samsung C&T is building the plant in a consortium with local contractor Trojan General Contracting
Lee met executives from Samsung C&T and Samsung E&A as Samsung explores opportunities in AI data centers and energy infrastructure in the Middle East
stories.lenovo: Samsung's group play (power, EPC, memory) could bundle into Gulf AI campuses; watch for a DC EPC award.
stories.arabic: زار رئيس سامسونج لي جاي يونغ موقع محطة الظفرة للطاقة في أبوظبي، والتقى مسؤولي سامسونج سي آند تي وسامسونج إي آند إيه لبحث مشاريع جديدة في الطاقة ومراكز بيانات الذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: Egypt, Huawei discuss creating national AI-powered digital pathology network
stories.summary: Egypt's health minister held talks with Huawei on a national AI-powered digital pathology and remote-diagnosis network linking hospitals and oncology centres. Talks only; no contract.
bullets: Health Minister Khaled Abdel-Ghaffar held talks with Huawei representatives on a national digital pathology and remote diagnosis network powered by AI
The network aims to digitise tissue and cell examinations using AI and allow Egyptian specialists to prepare pathology reports remotely
The project aims to establish an integrated network for archiving and sharing digital slides between hospitals and oncology centres in different governorates
stories.lenovo: Huawei is shaping Egypt's health-AI architecture pre-tender; overlap with ISG storage and inference and SSG integration.
stories.arabic: بحث وزير الصحة المصري مع هواوي إنشاء شبكة وطنية للباثولوجيا الرقمية والتشخيص عن بُعد بالذكاء الاصطناعي تربط المستشفيات ومراكز الأورام في المحافظات.

stories.title: Gartner Forecasts Worldwide IT Spending to Grow 15% in 2027, Totaling $7.35 Trillion
stories.summary: Gartner forecasts 2027 IT spending of $7.35tn (+15%), with Data Center Systems +55.5% and Devices +8.1%; memory prices have more than doubled in 12 months and memflation should persist through 2027 (John-David Lovelock).
bullets: Worldwide IT spending is expected to reach $7.35 trillion in 2027, up 15% from 2026
Data center systems spending is forecast at $879 billion in 2026 (up 73.8%) and $1,366 billion in 2027 (up 55.5%), while devices reach $916 billion in 2027 (up 8.1%)
Over the past 12 months memory prices have more than doubled, and John-David Lovelock said the memflation effect is expected to persist through 2027
stories.lenovo: ISG demand is growing far faster than devices and IDG is ASP-led; keep price protection and size Gulf AI capacity for an upward-revising market.
stories.arabic: توقعت غارتنر أن يبلغ الإنفاق العالمي على تقنية المعلومات 7.35 تريليون دولار في 2027 بنمو 15%، مع نمو أنظمة مراكز البيانات 55.5%، واستمرار تضخم أسعار الذاكرة حتى 2027.

stories.title: Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA Adds a 256-CPU Vera Rack, a Groq 3 LPU Inference Rack, and a 64GB GB10 Desktop
stories.summary: At GTC Berlin Dell launched the PowerEdge M9882 Vera rack, R8822 (shipping October), XE9810 Groq LPU rack, a DSX POD modular DC for early 2027 and a 64GB GB10 desktop.
bullets: The PowerEdge M9882 is a 48U rack with 256 NVIDIA Vera CPUs, available in Q1 CY27
The PowerEdge XE9810 is Dell's first Groq LPU rack-scale inference system, available in Q1 CY27, and the air-cooled PowerEdge R8822 ships in October 2026
A Dell Modular Data Center with NVIDIA DSX POD is slated for early 2027, and a 64GB Dell Pro Precision with GB10 arrives October 23, 2026
stories.lenovo: Dell is first with a containerised DSX POD and a shipping Vera server, exactly what Gulf fast-capacity buyers will see; Lenovo needs its DSX POD and Vera dates in META hands now.
stories.arabic: أطلقت ديل في مؤتمر GTC برلين خادم باور إيدج M9882 بـ256 معالج فيرا ورف استدلال بمعالجات Groq 3 ومركز بيانات معيارياً بتصميم DSX POD مطلع 2027.

stories.title: SentinelOne and Lenovo Expand Partnership to Bring AI Security & Governance to the ThinkShield Security Portfolio
stories.summary: SentinelOne Prompt Security joins Lenovo ThinkShield, giving visibility and control over AI tools and agents on Lenovo endpoints.
bullets: The expanded partnership brings SentinelOne Prompt Security to the Lenovo ThinkShield portfolio, building on the companies' existing EDR collaboration
Security teams gain visibility into and control over AI agents and AI use on Lenovo ThinkShield endpoints
Nima Baiati of Lenovo said SentinelOne Prompt Security adds another layer of trust into the ThinkShield ecosystem
stories.lenovo: Ready message for KSA government and BFSI accounts worried about AI data leakage; bundle into AI-PC fleet offers.
stories.arabic: وسّعت سنتينل وان ولينوفو شراكتهما بإضافة حل Prompt Security إلى منظومة ThinkShield لتوفير الرؤية والتحكم في استخدام أدوات ووكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي على أجهزة لينوفو.

stories.title: Meta Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
stories.summary: Q3 revenue $64.60bn (+26%), capex $34.91bn; 2026 capex guidance narrowed to $135-145bn; Q4 revenue guidance $73-76bn.
bullets: Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year, and net income was $9.86 billion including a $9.89 billion charge
Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $34.91 billion in the third quarter
2026 capital expenditures are expected in the range of $135-145 billion, and fourth quarter revenue is expected in the range of $73-76 billion
stories.lenovo: Hyperscale capex is holding, keeping GPU and memory allocation tight for Gulf buyers.
stories.arabic: أعلنت ميتا إيرادات الربع الثالث 2026 بقيمة 64.6 مليار دولار بنمو 26%، وإنفاقاً رأسمالياً 34.9 مليار دولار، مع تضييق توقعات إنفاق 2026 إلى 135–145 مليار دولار.

stories.title: Handful of Micron workers strike in Taiwan
stories.summary: The Taoyuan union's one-day strike went ahead but AFP saw only five strikers against more than 2,000 planned; talks continue Friday.
bullets: Five striking workers were seen outside the Taoyuan plant, where more than 2,000 employees had planned to stop work
The Taoyuan union is demanding a one-off bonus of 83 months' salary and a permanent system sending 15% of operating profits to quarterly worker bonuses
Talks with the company were set to continue on Friday, and Micron said it remains eager to maintain continuous communication and dialogue with the union
stories.lenovo: Micron Taiwan supply risk has faded; price, not supply interruption, drives IDG/ISG deal desks (OPP-088).
stories.arabic: نُفّذ إضراب نقابة تاويوان في مصنع ميكرون بتايوان ليوم واحد بمشاركة محدودة لم تتجاوز خمسة عمال أمام المصنع، مع استئناف المفاوضات يوم الجمعة.

stories.title: [News] Micron Reportedly Rules Out 4F² DRAM Scaling, Backs 6F² and 3D DRAM in Next-Gen Memory Roadmap
stories.summary: Micron CTO Scott DeBoer: 4F2 not on the roadmap; 1-delta in volume 2H27 with DDR6, LPDDR6, HBM5 and vHBM; G11 NAND above 400 layers ramps 2H27.
bullets: Scott DeBoer, Micron's president and chief technology and products officer, said 4F² is not on the roadmap right now
The 1δ node is expected in volume production in 2H 2027 with a mid-20% bit-density gain, supporting DDR6, LPDDR6, HBM5 and vertical HBM
G11 NAND ramps in 2H 2027 with more than 400 layers and twice the bit density of G9
stories.lenovo: No new-node relief before 2H27, consistent with memory inflation through 2027; note DDR6 and 1TB RDIMM timing for 2028 server roadmaps.
stories.arabic: أكدت ميكرون أن تقنية 4F² ليست ضمن خارطة طريقها، وأنها ستطور ذاكرة 6F² وثلاثية الأبعاد، مع إنتاج عقدة 1δ وذاكرة NAND G11 بأكثر من 400 طبقة في النصف الثاني من 2027.

stories.title: Seoul stocks slide over 3% on profit-taking amid persistent AI woes
stories.summary: Kospi -3.52%; Samsung -4.03%, SK hynix -5.49%; Daishin's Lee Kyoung-min cites AI profitability worries after Meta and Tesla, and the end of SK hynix's buyback.
bullets: The Kospi fell 201.8 points, or 3.52 percent, to 5,533.77
Samsung Electronics dropped 4.03 percent to 214,500 won and SK hynix fell 5.49 percent to 1.22 million won
Daishin Securities analyst Lee Kyoung-min said Meta and Tesla results did not ease worries about profitability amid heavy AI investment, and the end of SK hynix's share buyback removed support
stories.lenovo: Memory equities wobble while prices keep rising; do not present share falls as a price-cut signal to customers.
stories.arabic: تراجع مؤشر كوسبي 3.52% مع هبوط سامسونج 4.03% وإس كيه هاينكس 5.49% وسط مخاوف بشأن ربحية استثمارات الذكاء الاصطناعي وانتهاء برنامج إعادة شراء أسهم هاينكس.

opportunities.account: Nebius / HUMAIN / DataVolt – Oxagon AI campus, NEOM
opportunities.title: Win the server, storage and cooling OEM slot for Nebius's 50 MW at HUMAIN/DataVolt Oxagon
opportunities.why_now: Nebius named HUMAIN's first customer for up to 50 MW of the first 100 MW, live from Q4 2027, on NVIDIA compute with no OEM named; Dell already shipping a DSX POD modular design.
opportunities.entry_point: Nebius EMEA infrastructure procurement; DataVolt CEO office and head of investments (DCD Connect MENA 26-27 Oct); MIS as HUMAIN's design-and-build contractor.
opportunities.owner: ISG KSA AI-factory lead with the NVIDIA alliance manager

opportunities.title: Contain Huawei at DEWA and win Moro Hub's regulated and AI workloads with a trusted non-Huawei stack
opportunities.why_now: DEWA signed Huawei through Moro Hub for ICT, networks, data centres and servers at WETEX (21 Oct).
opportunities.entry_point: Moro Hub CTO and sovereign-cloud product leads; TCS energy practice (DEWA International IT/OT partner).
opportunities.owner: ISG UAE account lead with government affairs

opportunities.account: Aleria (Abu Dhabi) – 60 MW Rubin site and 10 MW Hyperfusion modular DC
opportunities.title: Position Lenovo GPU servers and Neptune cooling for Aleria's 14,000-GPU and modular builds
opportunities.why_now: Two GPU builds announced 21 Oct with no server OEM; the 10 MW modular site targets Q1 2027 with a 45°C warm-water loop.
opportunities.entry_point: Aleria infrastructure leadership; NVIDIA Cloud Partner team for the UAE; Hyperfusion (OPP-096).

opportunities.account: Zain–Ooredoo regional tower platform (ITK Kuwait, Al Abraj Qatar)
opportunities.title: Edge compute at 4,000 GCC towers through the new Zain–Ooredoo TowerCo
opportunities.why_now: First closing of the 50:50 tower platform on an infrastructure-as-a-service model; more portfolios to come.
opportunities.entry_point: TowerCo leadership once named; Zain Group and Ooredoo infrastructure strategy teams.

opportunities.account: Open Innovation AI / VivoPower – GCC sovereign AI data centres
opportunities.title: Get Lenovo validated under Open Innovation AI's stack for VivoPower's first GCC sovereign AI site
opportunities.why_now: 1 GW three-year heads of agreement covering the GCC signed 21 Oct; hardware undisclosed.
